The contraction criterion and fixed uniform comparator follow directly; 120482 independent exact-rational assertions passed, with analytical proof covering the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The sharp phase boundary T=3, unaveraged duplicate-collision stability criterion beta<2/T, and nonzero 1/9 optimal squared-error floor identify a rigorous high-concurrency limitation of squared-residual adaptivity absent for fixed uniform sampling. This is a natural complete minimax benchmark for recent empirical asynchrony/row-choice research, not merely a parameter substitution. Its controlled orthogonal model deliberately separates collisions from matrix conditioning.
